description: Free-tier endpoint. A golfer's completed rounds, newest first, with strokes, score to par and hole counts (eagles, birdies, pars, bogeys, doubles), plus last-5/10/20 averages. Every player in the field, back to 2024; a round in progress is never included. Filter by tour (pga, dp_world, liv, lpga, korn_ferry, champions). Hole counts are null on DP World, LPGA and some LIV rounds. Useful for: 'Scheffler's last 10 rounds', 'how has Bryson scored on LIV lately'.

player.description: Player name (case/accents ignored) or ESPN athlete id.

tour.description: Optional comma-separated tours: pga, dp_world, liv, lpga, korn_ferry, champions. Omit for all.

name: propline_get_golf_rounds
title: Get a golfer's round history
